summary: Coherent Corp. filed an 8-K reporting special performance stock unit awards granted on August 27, 2026 to its CEO, CFO, and other executives, with target values totaling $100 million. Vesting requires share price milestones and relative total shareholder return hurdles through 2030. The filing is a routine executive compensation disclosure under Items 5.02 and 8.01, not a special situation.
